contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Brooch. Cast hinged Colchester Derivative Brooch, Mackreth type CD H9, or East Midlands Enamelled. Tubular wings clenched behind are decorated with a single inscribed line at each end on the front side, and may retain an axis bar for a hinged pin (lost). A D-section bow meets the wings.
